thirty_second_pitch: The Jing-Zhang Many Hands Line turns the often invisible work behind an AI city—maintenance, logistics, care, service and testing—into visible public infrastructure. Three reversible prototypes start with ordinary, non-digital services, then add minimal-data tools only after accessibility, labor, safety and community gates pass.
disclaimer: All boundaries and geometries are provisional. This package is not an approval, investment commitment, government endorsement or construction document.
participation_invitation: We invite maintainers, shift workers, disabled people, caregivers, residents, operators and independent evaluators to test the three prototype passports before any scale-up.
